messages:
Carla (Support): @Ben seeing a cluster of 5xx + timeouts from hosted API starting ~10:03 UTC, several customers complaining about long tail latency.
Ben (Eng): which route/tenant? any correlation ids?
Carla (Support): /v1/generate, tenant=acme-inc, corr=8a7f3c. p95 ~3.2s -> p99 ~18s, a bunch of 504s.
Dave (SRE): InfraBot shows thinpool-3 queue_depth climbing to 1024 at 10:02:41. Continuous-batcher backlog rising steadily.
InfraBot: [ALERT] service=hosted-gateway queue_depth=1024 inflight=960 kv_cache_miss_rate=0.67 droprate=0.06
Maya (PS): Customer payloads are short (~20-40 tokens) and bursty; weird that batchers are clogging.
Ben (Eng): any logs for corr=8a7f3c? need model decode times + batch sizes.
Carla (Support): pasting excerpt: "ERROR gateway: request timeout after 25s, reason=dequeue_timeout, tenant=acme-inc, corr=8a7f3c"
Ben (Eng): dequeue_timeout means request waited too long in the batcher queue rather than being early-rejected. Hypothesis: KV cache cold-miss on model -> single requests take multi-second stalls causing batches to grow.
Dave (SRE): quick local repro: spawn 300 concurrent short requests with tenant header -> thinpool-3 queue hits depth ceiling in ~40s and p99 rockets. Sharing repro script.
Carla (Support): customer wants ETA, they saw errors for ~20 minutes and impacted production.
Ben (Eng): mitigation options: 1) bump continuous-batcher max_depth 1024->2048 (memory risk), 2) force KV cache pre-warm for acme-inc (fast), 3) apply short-term concurrency throttle on tenant (low friction).
Maya (PS): propose: pre-warm KV + temporary throttle + offer reserved capacity to customer while we investigate.
Dave (SRE): applying throttle rule for tenant=acme-inc now (rate limit concurrent requests -> 60). Monitoring.
InfraBot: deploy started: rule=tenant-throttle apply->thinpool-3 (initiated)
Ben (Eng): also toggled kv_prewarm=true for that tenant on thinpool-3, watching kv_hit_rate. If misses persist we'll consider model-variant fallback to quantized runtime.
Dave (SRE): update: 70s after throttle, queue_depth dropped to 420, p99 down to 2.1s, 5xx count decreased 85%.
Carla (Support): told customer we've applied throttle and will follow up with deeper RCA and timeline. Customer accepted temporary throttle. :pray:
Ben (Eng): will run a focused postmortem looking at sequence of KV misses, batcher scheduling, and whether thinpool sizing needs adjustment for short-burst workloads.
Carla (Support): logging this escalation as ESC-2026-312 and closing the live thread; will reopen if customer sees recurrence.
